name: jira-readonly
description: Read-only Jira MCP server configuration. Provides access to Jira issues and project context without write permissions.
notes: Set JIRA_URL to your Jira instance URL (e.g., https://yourorg.atlassian.net).
Set JIRA_EMAIL to the email address associated with your Jira account.
Set JIRA_API_TOKEN to an Atlassian API token (not your password).
Jira integration is optional. Reviews work without it.
